name: Concrete gravity base structure
description: Large reinforced/prestressed concrete caisson that resists overturning and sliding by self-weight; often provides oil storage and flotation during tow-out. Primary source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Offshore_concrete_structure

specifications.metric: number of major concrete offshore structures built
specifications.basis: Wikipedia Offshore concrete structure: at least 47 major concrete offshore structures built since first North Sea installation in 1973
Wikipedia Offshore concrete structure: concrete gravity platforms economical for water depths larger than 150 m; most need no additional fixing due to large foundation and weight
Wikipedia Condeep: tallest Condeep, total height 472 m, deployed 1995, placed at 300 m depth and dug 35 m into seabed
Wikipedia Condeep: Gullfaks C rests 217 m below sea surface, total height 380 m, displacement 1.4-1.5 million t

applications: Large reinforced/prestressed concrete caisson that resists overturning and sliding by self-weight; often provides oil storage and flotation during tow-out.
